title: Financial Sales Specialist
teaser: We are expanding our team: As a Financial Sales Specialist, you will drive Cisco sales and financing growth across Spain and Portugal by delivering creative payment solutions and supporting strategic sales opportunities. Ideal candidates bring proven sales expertise and strong relationship-building skills within the financial sector.
description:
The Team

The Financial Sales Specialist (FSS) will increase Cisco sales and financing volumes in Iberia Region (Spain & Portugal) by effectively providing a range of creative payment solutions to Cisco customers.

The FSS will be closely involved in customer negotiations and communicates with the Cisco salesforce and with Cisco partners to solicit their support in seeing opportunities for Cisco.

Moreover the FSS educates Cisco sales colleagues and partners to understand how creative financial solutions can increase, build or pull forward sales opportunities. The individual will work closely with Cisco customers and partners, building relationships with finance and business owners, as well as supporting the transformation to new business models.

Role & Responsibilities

In this exciting, fast paced role as a Financial Solutions Specialist, you will:

Align closely with Cisco's Priorities and Initiatives within the sales geography.

Main focus will be Enterprise, Commercial & Public Sector Segments in Iberia (Spain & Portugal).

Build and maintain relationships with Cisco Sales Leaders and account managers.

Build high level relationships with Cisco strategic partners and support the transformation to managed services / as a Service models.

Where needed work closely together with Finance Partners on the enablement and execution of transactions

Meet and exceed quarterly and annual targets

Provide creative deal structuring for strategic sales opportunities

Present, negotiate and close financial solutions, carry out documentation to Cisco Capital's guidelines including preparing internal paperwork necessary to turn around a financial transaction (e.g. credit application, legal term sheet etc.)

Connect with and train Cisco colleagues and Cisco Partner account managers

Be part of the business planning of selected accounts and strategic Cisco partners planning

Maintain awareness of competitor activities

Minimum Qualifications

4+ years of proven sales expertise with a "hunter" mentality, capable of developing new business opportunities and solution-led selling with customers and partners.

Strong relationship-building skills with confidence to engage senior executives, including CFOs, and collaborate effectively across internal and external stakeholders.

Solid financial acumen, including knowledge of commercial finance models (e.g., Pay as you Grow, Software Financing), financial mathematics, pricing, and IFRS/accounting principles.

Excellent communication skills in Spanish and English, both oral and written.

Proficiency in Salesforce, Microsoft Office, and AI-driven productivity tools.

Desired Skills

Innovative and creative thinking with a proactive, achievement-driven mindset.

Outstanding relationship management and ability to expand existing accounts and influence business outcomes.

High level of professionalism, integrity, and teamwork.

Strong presentation skills with meticulous attention to accuracy and detail.

Broad expertise in finance documentation, including negotiating and explaining complex financial documents to customers and partners.
